dedupe_keys.name: electricity price results generated with fansi for case study 2 of man0euvre

description: This dataset contains electricity prices generated by the stochastic FanSi power-market model for Man0EUvRE Case Study 2. It represents the European electricity system in 2050 under the EU EnVis-2060 NECP Essentials scenario, using historical weather variability from 1991 to 2020. Each weather year uses a stylised 364-day calendar with 2,912 three-hour steps. The baseline is compared with Norwegian hydropower flexibility, elastic demand, time-shiftable demand and stronger cross-border transmission. Outputs are provided in IAMC and two-dimensional tabular layouts; Zenodo lists a CSV file and a ZIP archive. The source distinguishes weather-year labels from the modelled 2050 price column. These results support energy-planning scenario analysis and comparison of flexibility options. Anders Arvesen of SINTEF Energy Research deposited the results for free access under CC BY 4.0. The related plan4res record describes separate 2030 results. A limitation is that stylised calendars and scenario assumptions limit transfer to observed market prices.
